Chapter 6472: Lord Of Paragon

Chapter 6472: Lord Of Paragon

An invisible hand pressed Paragon into Skyraiser Ancestor, engraving its power onto him.

The rest of Paragon continued to push against Gold Village, breaking it down inch by inch.

“What is happening?” Alch-deer was confused since they couldn’t turn the tides.

Paragon was being pushed by an invisible hand or unknown power not originating from Skyraiser Ancestor.

“Die!” Skyraiser treated Paragon like a new hammer for another smash.

This obliterated all external grand dao power and affinities. Cracks appeared around the fabrics of the illusory village.

“Show yourself!” Li Qiye didn’t give a damn about the attack since his focus was on something else.

“Boom!” He took one step forward and conjured a primordial beam. Dao, golden, and paragon powers were feeble before the primordial force.

The attack faced the brunt of the attack and didn’t last for a second. Next was the empowered Skyraiser.

However, the blessing disintegrated and he was blasted flying. Fortunately, he was not the final target.

Li Qiye’s final target was the empty sky behind him where Paragon used to be. Suddenly, countless barriers appeared and were erased by the primordial force.

A figure finally appeared in the middle of the barriers - a middle-aged man in a strange state, a fiery being amidst a great expanse made up of paragon power.

The fire shrouded him, leaving only a silhouette.

“Who is he?” Alch-deer and the others realized this man was the one who blessed Skyraiser Ancestor.

“Looks like you’re rather active and having fun.” Li Qiye smiled while looking at the cluster of flames.

“I am the lord of Paragon. Join me and you can be blessed with this power as well.” The figure spoke.

“Oh? How strong is your paragon power?” Li Qiye asked.

“As strong as however much your heart can endure.” The fiery figure said.

Listeners became amazed by the potential.

“Unfortunately, I am not interested in this game. It is not too late to follow me.” Li Qiye shook his head.

This fiery figure turned out to be one of the three souls. It was located in Paragon Spring and created the dream realm known as Paragon.

The difference was that the soul in Gold Village only wanted to laze around aimlessly. This soul, on the other hand, acted as the lord of Paragon.

“I am unbeatable here for eternity, why would I leave with you?” The figure shook his head.

“Now that’s more like you, the gamble with the soul planting might have worked.” Li Qiye said.

“What nonsense are you talking about?” The figure became aggressive: “Accept my grace and become unbeatable, lest you risk antagonizing me.”

“And if I pick the latter?” Li Qiye asked.

“Damnation in hell.” The figure declared.

“Enough of this game.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Who wants to be blessed?” The figure’s voice echoed across the rest of Paragon.

“Me?” Someone came with his kingdom - a child with eight arms.

Each arm had eight kingdoms while within these kingdoms were more arms with their own kingdoms, creating an endless loop.

“Eight-armed Immortal Child!” Everyone saw the newcomer.

“Come, I will make you an unbeatable paragon.” The fiery figure shouted.

“Boom!” He poured the power of Paragon into the cultivator.

“Yes!” The immortal child’s worlds resonated and accepted the power influx.

Since his body alone was not sufficient as a vessel, his three thousand worlds became useful.
